items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Oh, that's when you were with Duke? Yes. ... It was all original tunes of Duke, and they called it the Jungle Band in those days

ctx.x: Oh, that's when you were with Duke?

Yes. -- and so he goes to Duke and he never even asked me -- because you know how Tyree and I was, you know. We was very close, very, very close. People don't know, really, how close we were, you know. Tyree goes to Duke and I come to work the next night and here's this mute and plunger in front of my chair, and I said, "Oh, no." So Duke told me that, you know, "Tyree told me that you could play anything. So he told me that you could do this." And do you know that night he called Trans-Bluecency on me, he called…
